svg.title: Five modules, five habits. Module 1: break the job into steps an AI, a bit of code or a tool can do. Module 2: give the reviewer a new fact, not just a second look. Module 3: let the AI ask for tools, and let it write code when small tools keep piling up. Module 4, the one worth rereading: measure, and count which step causes the errors before fixing anything. Module 5: hand over only as much control as the job needs.
